description: Inventory from T-003, read-only group: ServerPatchAdvisor, PackageSecurityUpdatesInsightRunner, ServerInventoryProbeScript, ServerMetricsGuestScript. These read apt state rather than changing it, so a broken repo does not abort anything - it makes them report LESS. PackageSecurityUpdatesInsightRunner runs 'apt list --upgradable' against whatever the cached index holds, so a host whose apt-get update has failed for weeks reports few or no pending security updates and reads as healthy. Detect a stale or failing index and surface it as its own finding, rather than letting it suppress the signal.
title: Surface a broken apt index instead of reporting a healthy patch state
